model_answer:
**Short answer:** In 2024, BBSI (Barrett Business Services, Inc.) nominated an eight‑person, all‑incumbent slate for election at its June 3, 2024 Annual Meeting (2024 proxy statement filed April 22, 2024):

| Nominee | Principal Occupation (per 2024 proxy) | Director Since |
|---|---|---|
| Thomas J. Carley | Retired COO, Urth Organic Corporation | 2000 |
| Joseph S. Clabby | Retired Vice President, Chubb Limited | 2022 |
| Thomas B. Cusick | Retired Executive Advisor, Columbia Sportswear | 2016 |
| Gary E. Kramer | President & CEO of BBSI | 2020 |
| Anthony Meeker | Retired Managing Director, Victory Capital Management | 1993 |
| Carla A. Moradi | Board member of BBSI and Patriot Growth Insurance Services | 2021 |
| Alexandra Morehouse | Board member of BBSI and Evalueserve, Inc. | 2022 |
| Vincent P. Price | Advisor to the CEO, Cambia Health Solutions | 2017 |

Key details:
- The proxy explicitly stated that **“All of our director nominees are currently serving on the Board”** — i.e., **no brand‑new director was nominated in 2024**; the slate was a re‑nomination of the sitting eight‑member board (the board had been reduced from nine to eight in 2023 when Jon Justesen stepped down).
- All eight were elected at the June 3, 2024 annual meeting (per the 8‑K filed June 5, 2024), each for a one‑year term ending at the 2025 annual meeting.
- The only 2024 board‑related change was structural, not a new nominee: in December 2024 the board created a **Vice Chairman** role and appointed sitting director **Joseph S. Clabby** to it (effective December 13, 2024). (The next new director, Mark S. Finn, was appointed in April 2025.)

Sources: BBSI 2024 DEF 14A (filed 4/22/2024), BBSI 8‑K (6/5/2024) with 2024 annual meeting voting results, and BBSI 8‑K/press release (12/17/2024).
judge_reason: All eight official nominees are identified correctly, with no contradiction.
